forecast.admission: proposed only; pending independent forecast, remaining aggregate budget and dispatch review
limitations: Linear projection plus cross-check and explicit allowances, not a guaranteed bound; full 1GiB memory/IO pressure may be nonlinear.
1m baseline control 3 pairs used 4GiB seeds/observers; proposed full uses 1 pair, two workers and two observers.
Old full 4GiB run used other runner and binary hashes and candidate source d1c9; cross-check only.
Workers have 1800s per-command timeout and OOM/timeout/incomplete invalidates case.
Full 512MiB conditional only after 1GiB full success, with its own case-matched forecast and admission.

parent_review.judgment: Planning estimate admitted in principle, contingent on frozen build-only apt mirror fix, actual unchanged baseline binary, source/measurement identity and fresh aggregate reservation. Full-scale pressure remains unmeasured; no guaranteed bound, success claim or D11/H2 waiver.

plans.depends_on: Valid matching1m1024MiB A/A evidence, revalidated raw receipts and hashes. New full-control production and ordinary measurement source byte-identical to55; only reviewed build preparation and tests changed. Fresh source/remote/budget admission required.
plans.purpose: Two full-scale baseline scans at1GiB, exploratory capacity/pressure evidence only; no source improvement, exact minimum, D11 or H2 waiver

stop_rules: Any build/worker timeout, OOM, receipt/semantic/integrity/disk admission failure stops the case; no expected-OOM waiver or automatic retry.
One A/A pair is capacity/pressure exploration, not repeated qualification or a source optimization.
512MiB full case requires valid1GiB full completion and separately frozen case-matched forecast and admission.
No scan-only refresh profile-v2 or memory.events.local is claimed. Endpoint memory.stat is not peak decomposition.
